items.activity: Organize a sample vendor list of about 20 rows by service type and payment status, using sort and filter.
items.why: Excel is a required skill, and the interview includes a short spreadsheet exercise.
items.doneWhen: You can sort and filter the list without looking up the steps.
items.evidenceToAdd: Describe which tasks you completed and when, as a practice project.

items.activity: Create a small monthly expense tracker with a SUM total for each category.
items.why: The posting names SUM as a required formula.
items.doneWhen: The totals update correctly when you change a number.
items.evidenceToAdd: Add it as a clearly labeled practice project.

items.activity: Produce a simple one-page weekly expense summary from your tracker.
items.why: A short work sample shows you can turn data into the basic weekly reports this role prepares.
items.doneWhen: You have a one-page summary you could show in an interview.
items.evidenceToAdd: Include the work sample as a practice project if appropriate.

items.activity: Write one or two sentences about the emails, notices, or meeting notes you wrote as an administrative coordinator.
items.why: Clear written communication is required, and your profile doesn't show it yet.
items.doneWhen: Your example says what you wrote, for whom, and how often.
items.evidenceToAdd: Add the example to your profile once you've confirmed it's accurate.

items.activity: Ask whether Outlook, Teams, and shared-drive training is part of onboarding.
items.why: This is a preferred skill, and the posting says refresher training on Excel and Teams is included.
items.doneWhen: You know whether training covers it.

items.activity: In free Outlook.com and Teams accounts, schedule a recurring meeting and share a file in a chat.
items.why: Basic practice helps you join the team's tools quickly, even with training provided.
items.doneWhen: You've sent a meeting invite and shared a file in Teams.
items.evidenceToAdd: Describe what you set up, as a practice project.
